title: How My <g>AI Ops Team</g>
Actually Works
subtitle: Nothing ships without my yes. 8 steps, one loop.

cards.title: It watches for triggers
cards.body: A new lead, a client message or a Monday 7am timer starts a run. No trigger, no work.
cards.best: Work that starts the same way every time.

cards.title: A worker drafts the job
cards.body: One room drafts the email, post or audit from my own examples, not from scratch.
cards.best: Drafts you write ten times a week.

cards.title: A second AI grades it
cards.body: Every draft is scored against my best past work. Three fix rounds max, then it comes to me.
cards.best: Quality without reading it all twice.

cards.title: Nothing leaves without my yes
cards.body: Emails, posts and invoices wait in one inbox. I approve, edit or reject in one click.
cards.best: Owners who won't let AI email clients alone.

cards.title: Only approved work goes out
cards.body: A hard lock checks for an approved id. There is no way around it.
cards.best: Anything with money or a client's name on it.

cards.title: It checks what happened
cards.body: Replies after 5 days, post reach after 48 hours, invoice paid or not.

cards.title: Every no becomes a lesson
cards.body: A rejection or an edit is saved as a good vs bad example, so the next draft is closer.
cards.best: Teaching AI your taste without rules.

cards.title: One memory for everything
cards.body: Every room reads and writes one shared database. One id per client, everywhere.
